sentence: This project studies how natural language processing models perform for different communities and builds a tool that helps communities decide whether to use them.
This project builds methods that combine many large datasets to find groups of similar subjects in neuroimaging data.
This project studies how temperature and water availability change how trees grow from day to day across the United States.
This project gets a machine that measures the heat, electrical and magnetic properties of materials at low temperatures.
This project builds two laboratory courses, one on cell therapy and one on biomanufacturing.
This project tests how increased temperature and competition with neighbors affect whether plant species survive and live together in alpine communities.
This project brings together researchers at a conference on quantum fluids and solids, including superconductivity and quantum computing.
This project uses theory and numerical methods to study how electrons interact in simple quantum devices.
This project builds an open-source system that helps people organize video and ask complex queries about video from many cameras.
This project uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to choose and tune the algorithm that solves each mathematical optimization problem.
This project studies how the atom-level details of biological filaments change how the filaments deform.
This project explores artificial intelligence for computational creativity, including creative generative models and ways to evaluate generated content.
This project builds machine learning tools that learn fair and explainable court schedules so fewer defendants miss court dates.
This project builds an open-source ecosystem around a fast simulator that models heat flow in advanced semiconductor systems.
This project develops simulation methods to follow how molecules move after strong laser pulses and how they fragment.
This project studies how the number of copies of detoxification genes affects how woodrats process plant toxins, survive and reproduce.
This project builds mathematical tools to show how superspreaders let harmful mutations persist, and tests them on contact networks of wild Asian elephants.
